reviewType: Read-only source and existing-test review; no tests or runtime probes were run
scope: Existing object authorization, authorization regression, Staff scope, and pagination tests

result.summary: No P0/P1 BOLA or IDOR issue was identified in the reviewed role, owner, and cinema boundaries. This is a focused source review, not exhaustive ASVS/API Top 10 certification or adversarial testing.

coveredBoundaries: Customer-scoped holds, orders, mock payment completion, and order/ticket reads are bound to the authenticated Customer; the webhook uses separate signature and payload/order binding.
Staff check-in checks assigned cinema and ticket order/payment state before mutation; denied operations have state/audit assertions in existing tests.
Admin routes require the Admin role and use route-specific schemas, state guards, and audit writes where applicable.
Authentication reloads current role, cinema assignment, and authVersion for each request; stale tokens are rejected on subsequent requests after a permission change.

observations.item: A request that already passed requireAuth can continue in its handler if role or cinema assignment is revoked while that same request is running.
observations.status: No in-flight revocation test found; relevance depends on whether the product requires revocation to cancel already-authorized requests.

observations.item: The in-memory rate limiter protects login and registration; equivalent limits were not identified on booking and check-in actions.
observations.status: Potential API resource-consumption concern, not a confirmed authorization bypass or explicit current acceptance requirement.

observations.item: Staff receives different status codes for a valid QR outside the assigned cinema (403) and an unknown QR (404).
observations.status: Could provide an existence signal; QR entropy and the absence of ticket details in the denial reduce exposure. Consider uniform responses if the product requires reducing this oracle.

limitations: No tests, DAST, database access, Docker actions, or runtime requests were performed as part of this review.
The existing route matrix maps only ASVS v5.0.0 8.2.1-8.2.3 and is not a complete ASVS or OWASP API Top 10 assessment.
Review findings do not establish behavior for unlisted consumers, every object/state/field combination, or production configuration.
